# United States Courts

> Official information portal for the federal judiciary, covering court structure, case types, administration, rules, forms, and services.

The United States Courts website is the public-facing resource for the Judicial Branch of the U.S. government. It provides authoritative information about federal courts, judges, court programs, filing systems, statistics, rules, educational materials, and judiciary administration.

## Federal Courts Overview

- [About Federal Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts): Overview of the federal judiciary’s role, structure, and constitutional foundation.
- [Court Role and Structure](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure): Explains how federal courts are organized and how they function.
- [Comparing Federal & State Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/comparing-federal-state-courts): Compares jurisdiction, structure, and authority of federal and state courts.
- [Court Website Links](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/court-website-links): Directory of official websites for federal courts nationwide.
- [FAQs: Court Information](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/faqs-court-information): Answers common questions about federal courts and court operations.

## Court Types

- [About the U.S. Courts of Appeals](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-courts-appeals): Describes appellate court jurisdiction, panels, and review of lower court decisions.
- [About U.S. District Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-district-courts): Explains trial court jurisdiction, case handling, and district court organization.
- [About U.S. Bankruptcy Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-bankruptcy-courts): Overview of bankruptcy courts and their role in insolvency proceedings.
- [Supreme Court Landmarks](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/supreme-court-landmarks): Educational resource on notable Supreme Court cases and constitutional history.
- [Authorized Judgeships](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/authorized-judgeships): Lists congressionally authorized judgeships across the federal judiciary.

## Types of Cases

- [Types of Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases): Introduction to the categories of matters heard in federal courts.
- [Civil Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/civil-cases): Explains civil litigation, parties, pleadings, and trial process.
- [Criminal Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/criminal-cases): Describes federal criminal proceedings from charge through sentencing.
- [Appeals](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/appeals): Explains appellate review, briefs, oral argument, and decisions.
- [Bankruptcy Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/bankruptcy-cases): Overview of bankruptcy case types and court procedures.

## Judges and Judgeships

- [About Federal Judges](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges): Overview of federal judges, appointments, tenure, and judicial roles.
- [Authorized Judgeships](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/authorized-judgeships): Current authorized judgeship counts by court and judicial district.
- [Judicial Vacancies](https://www.uscourts.gov/judges-judgeships/judicial-vacancies): Tracks current and future vacancies in federal judgeships.
- [Judicial Milestones](https://www.uscourts.gov/judges-judgeships/judicial-milestones): Highlights notable firsts and historical milestones in the federal judiciary.
- [Judges and Judgeships](https://www.uscourts.gov/judges-judgeships): Central hub for judgeship data, vacancies, and judiciary information.

## Court Programs and Services

- [Court Programs](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs): Overview of judiciary programs supporting court operations and public access.
- [Bankruptcy](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/bankruptcy): Resources and program information related to bankruptcy administration.
- [Federal Court Interpreters](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-programs/federal-court-interpreters): Information on interpreter services, certification, and court language access.
- [Jury Service](https://www.uscourts.gov/services-forms/jury-service): Explains federal jury service, eligibility, and juror responsibilities.
- [Defender Services](https://www.uscourts.gov/services-forms/defender-services): Information about representation for eligible defendants in federal court.

## Services and Forms

- [Services & Forms](https://www.uscourts.gov/services-forms): Portal for forms, fee information, juror resources, and court services.
- [Forms](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/forms): Access to official federal judiciary forms by category.
- [Fees](https://www.uscourts.gov/services-forms/fees): Fee schedules and payment-related information for federal courts.
- [Jury Service](https://www.uscourts.gov/services-forms/jury-service): Public guidance for summoned jurors and jury administration.
- [Bankruptcy Forms](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/forms/bankruptcy-forms): Official forms used in federal bankruptcy proceedings.
- [Civil Forms](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/forms/civil-forms): Official forms for civil actions and related filings.
- [Criminal Forms](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/forms/criminal-forms): Official forms used in federal criminal proceedings.

## Rules and Policies

- [Forms & Rules](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules): Entry point for federal rules, forms, and rulemaking materials.
- [Current Rules of Practice & Procedure](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/current-rules-practice-procedure): Current federal procedural rules for courts and litigants.
- [Pending Rules and Forms Amendments](https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/pending-rules-and-forms-amendments): Proposed amendments and related public notice materials.
- [Records Schedule](https://www.uscourts.gov/rules-policies/records-schedule): Judiciary records retention and disposition schedules.
- [Code of Conduct for United States Judges](https://www.uscourts.gov/rules-policies/judiciary-policies/code-conduct-united-states-judges): Ethical standards governing conduct of federal judges.

## Case Management and Electronic Filing

- [CM/ECF](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-records/electronic-filing-cmecf): Overview of the federal courts’ electronic case filing system.
- [PACER](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-records/find-case-pacer): Information on accessing federal court records through PACER.
- [Court Records](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-records): Resources for finding, filing, and managing federal court records.
- [Electronic Public Access Fee Schedule](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-records/electronic-public-access-fee-schedule): Fee details for electronic access to federal court records.
- [Bankruptcy Noticing Center](https://www.uscourts.gov/court-records/bankruptcy-noticing-center-bnc): Information about noticing services in bankruptcy cases.

## Data, Reports, and Statistics

- [Data & News](https://www.uscourts.gov/data-news): Hub for judiciary news, statistics, and reports.
- [Federal Court Management Statistics](https://www.uscourts.gov/statistics-reports/federal-court-management-statistics): Caseload and management statistics for federal courts.
- [Judicial Business of the United States Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/statistics-reports/judicial-business-united-states-courts): Annual statistical report on the business of the federal judiciary.
- [Caseload Statistics Data Tables](https://www.uscourts.gov/statistics-reports/caseload-statistics-data-tables): Detailed statistical tables on filings, terminations, and pending cases.
- [Bankruptcy Statistics](https://www.uscourts.gov/statistics-reports/analysis-reports/bankruptcy-statistics): Reports and analysis on bankruptcy filings and trends.

## Educational Resources

- [Educational Resources](https://www.uscourts.gov/educational-resources): Teaching and learning materials about the federal judiciary.
- [Supreme Court Landmarks](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/supreme-court-landmarks): Summaries of landmark Supreme Court decisions for educational use.
- [Comparing Federal & State Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/comparing-federal-state-courts): Educational comparison of court systems and jurisdiction.
- [Court Role and Structure](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure): Foundational explanation of how the federal judiciary is organized.
- [FAQs: Court Information](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/faqs-court-information): Introductory answers for students, researchers, and the public.
